rows.grounds: locative of placement; indicates the heart as the locus of installation
dative name of the deity addressed; compound arddha-lakṣmī-hari
dative apposition specifying the addressed figure as a deity
indeclinable salutation completing the dative formula

items.question: What salutation formula is to be installed in the heart for the deity Arddhalakṣmīhari?
premises: The wise practitioner installs names ending in the dative case with namaḥ.
The specified locus of installation is the heart.
items.inference: The formula 'obeisance to the deity Arddhalakṣmīhari' is to be placed in the heart.
uncertainties: The exact theological nuance of arddhalakṣmīhari as a specific form is not fully explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: In the heart, one places the salutation: 'Obeisance to the deity Arddhalakṣmīhari.'
